text: じめんを　つよく　ゆらし　てきに　だいダメージを　あたえる！

structure.jp: じめんを　つよく　ゆらし
だいダメージを　あたえる！

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: In writing, a verb with its ます taken off can join to the next action just like the て-form, meaning 'and'. ゆらし = 'shakes, and'

patterns.name: 〜く
patterns.explanation: Changing the い of a describing word to く makes it tell how an action is done. つよく　ゆらし = 'shakes strongly'
